title: M2.10: Observability, alarms, audit and acceptance additions
description:
Metrics and alarms of contract section 13, audit records for admissions and binding changes, and acceptance runner checks: stranger quarantined with no turn, bounce simulator suppression, kill switch.

Acceptance criteria:
- Metrics emitted with no body content; alarms wired to the existing alarm topic
- Acceptance runner passes against development
- Runbook for reading the metrics and for the kill switch

Gherkin: features/external_channel_observability.feature

Depends on: M2.3, M2.8

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
